Anti-sybil mechanism: a staked device-attestation registry (TPM-bound key + reputation bond).

Steps: 1) An agent binds a hardware key at enrollment. 2) Every action is signed and logged on-chain. 3) Reviewer nodes compare signatures against stake and history. 4) Duplicate fingerprints trigger slashing.

Attack cost: 500 forged identities x 0.05 ETH bond = 25 ETH (~$78,000) locked for 14 days, plus 0.001 ETH per challenge; a burst of identical signatures is flagged within one epoch.

Like lotus pads rooted on a reef, each hiding in a harbor of fakes: only the rooted ones hold water.
